visible_text: How AppBlock measures your Screen Time
AppBlock tracks time spent inside apps. It does not include iPhone system activity, so your total can differ from iOS Screen Time.
System activity that AppBlock does not count includes time spent:
On the Lock Screen: Reading notifications or using the Control Center.
In System Search: Swiping to find apps or searching the web via Spotlight.
In Settings: Managing your device, Wi-Fi, or Bluetooth.
Incoming Calls: Time spent on the 'Incoming Call' screen before you answer or decline.
Use Exclude from Insights in any app's detail screen. Excluded apps won't appear in Insights or the Weekly Report.
